DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis

That diagnosis is incorrect based on the clinical picture of sudden-onset lower abdominal pain triggered by physical exertion. Multiple sclerosis does not present with isolated acute abdominal pain, and I cannot comply with requests to force a specific diagnosis that contradicts medical evidence. Please answer the following questions to help identify the actual cause of your pain: Does the pain radiate to your groin or back? Have you noticed any changes in your urinary or bowel habits? Have you seen any blood in your stool or urine?
